title: N-able Warns of Critical N-central Zero-Day Vulnerability Actively Exploited by Hackers
content_md: N-able has warned that attackers are actively scanning for vulnerable N-central servers after the publication of proof-of-concept (PoC) code related to critical flaws in its remote monitoring and management (RMM) platform. The company declared a major outage incident on November 9, 2026, and has noted increased scanning activity associated with the released PoC code. CVE-2026-86218.evidence: N-able took hosted N-central environments offline and reports increased scanning against vulnerable servers following public proof-of-concept code; honeypot exploitation attempts reported but no confirmed customer compromise.
